name: unknown-property-stripped
description: an undescribed property on a known event is stripped with a warning naming its path, and the event itself survives intact
kill: stop stripping undescribed properties in enforceEvents — the warning may still fire, so eventAbsentPaths on the delivered TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT is what proves the property is gone rather than merely complained about

dotnet.intentional: the .NET client has no enforcement stage — SseEventStreamFormatter.ItemParser warns only about an unrecognised event TYPE, and an undescribed property is simply not mapped by System.Text.Json onto the typed event model — so the property is gone for the same reason but no warning names its path. The delivered payload IS observable here and the paths are restated rather than dropped: TEXT_MESSAGE_START and TEXT_MESSAGE_END only update EventStreamConverter's builder state and yield no ChatResponseUpdate, so the surviving TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT arrives at delivered index 1 rather than 2
